programme.title: Eurojackpot.
programme.desc: "Eurojackpot" - populiariausia ir didžiausius laimėjimus Europoje siūlanti loterija, kuri vienija net 18-os šalių žaidėjus. Žaidimai vyksta du kartus per savaitę ir jų metu dalyviai turi galimybę laimėti 10-120 mln. eurų Jackpotą. Šalia jo tik žaidėjų Lietuvoje laukia ir papildomo žaidimo "Džokeris" laimėjimai. Ši loterija daugybę mūsų tautiečių pavertė įspūdingų sumų laimėtojais, o keletą - net ir multimilijonieriais! (Eurojackpot).

programme.title: Ar galiu užeiti?.
programme.desc: Yra temų, kurios reikalauja išsamaus pokalbio. Šioje laidoje matysite interviu su įtakingais politikais, verslininkais ir visuomenininkais, išgirsite svarbias įžvalgas ir naujas įvykių detales. Laidoje dėmesys skiriamas visuomenę jaudinančioms, aktualioms temos ir pateikiamas platesnis suvokimo kampas. "Delfi interviu" vedėja - patyrusi žurnalistė, ilgametė naujienų portalo redaktorė Rasa Lukaitytė-Vnarauskienė. (Ar galiu užeiti?).

programme.title: Car Deals.
programme.desc: Laidoje "Car Deals" charizmatiškas duetas - Laurynas Boguševičius ir Paulius Mikolaitis - išbandys automobilius realiose, gyvenimiškose situacijose. Tai daugiau nei automobilio testas - tai linksmas, informatyvus ir naudingas turinys ne tik automobilių fanams, bet ir visiems, norintiems linksmai praleisti laiką. (Car Deals).

"Delfi TV" žiūrovams suteikia saugią galimybę savo namuose stebėti krikščioniškąsias apeigas ir dalyvauti Mišiose. Mišios transliuojamos iš Kauno arkikatedros bazilikos ir kitų Lietuvos šventovių. programme.title: Kenoloto.
programme.desc: "Kenoloto" - viena seniausių loterijų Lietuvoje, žaisti pradėta dar 1996 metais. Šiuo metu laimėjimus atnešantis kamuoliukai ridenami net tris kartus per dieną, o dalyviai patys gali rinktis, kelis iš jų bandys atspėti, savo laimingus skaičius bei bilieto kainą. Pastaroji prasideda nuo 0,25 Eur, o didžiausias galimas loterijos laimėjimas net 200 000 Eur! (Loterija "Keno Loto").

programme.title: Orijaus atostogos Lietuvoje.
programme.desc: Žinomas keliautojas Orijus Gasanovas visą vasarą keliaus po įvairius Lietuvos miestus ir miestelius, juose ieškodamas įdomiausių lankytinų vietų, pramogų ir herojų, taip didindamas atostogų Lietuvoje patrauklumą. (Orijaus atostogos Lietuvoje).

programme.title: Per pasaulį su Luku Vainavičiumi.
programme.desc: Kaip atrodo kelionė be pinigų į tolimą šalį? Nakvynė miške be palapinės ar gyvenimas oro uoste kelias dienas. Lukas Vainavičius keliauja per pasaulį ir fiksuoja viską kas jam nutinka kelyje. Autentiškas, nesurežisuotas, žemaitiškas kelionių dienoraštis. (Per pasaulį su Luku Vainavičiumi). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Švenčiam vasarą.
programme.desc: Vasaros turime nedaug, tad ją švęsti kviečiame iš širdies. Išskirtiniai kadrai ir pokalbiai su linksmais žmonėmis. Tiesiai iš linksmiausių mūsų festivalių. Švenčiam vasarą (Švenčiam vasarą).

programme.title: Burėmis į Arktį.
programme.desc: Kęstutis Juška, medikas iš Kauno, pametęs galvą dėl kelionių po gamtą, leidosi į iššūkį nuplaukti buriniu laiveliu į Arkties vandenyną į Šiaurę, už poliarinio rato. Laidose keliautojas parodys visą pasiruošimą kelionei nuo laivo paruošimo atšiauriomis sąlygomis iki inventoriaus, maisto ruošimo, aprangos ir kitų detalių. (Burėmis į arktį).

programme.title: Kasdienybės herojai.
programme.desc: Gyvenimo būdo laida "Kasdienybės herojai" - tai stiprių asmenybių jaudinančios gyvenimo istorijos. Kas savaitę - naujas interviu su gerai žinomu, o gal išskirtinį gyvenimo būdą pasirinkusiu žmogumi. Laidos vedėja - Rūta Lapė. (Kasdienybės herojai). Biografija. Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Šeimų virtuvė.
programme.desc: "Šeimų virtuvė" – kulinarinė pokalbių laida apie įdomius žmones, jų šeimos istorijas, vaikų auginimą, išmoktas pamokas ir, žinoma, maistą, kuris džiugina visus šeimos narius. programme.title: Eurojackpot.
programme.desc: "Eurojackpot" - populiariausia ir didžiausius laimėjimus Europoje siūlanti loterija, kuri vienija net 18-os šalių žaidėjus. Žaidimai vyksta du kartus per savaitę ir jų metu dalyviai turi galimybę laimėti 10-120 mln. eurų Jackpotą. Šalia jo tik žaidėjų Lietuvoje laukia ir papildomo žaidimo "Džokeris" laimėjimai. Ši loterija daugybę mūsų tautiečių pavertė įspūdingų sumų laimėtojais, o keletą - net ir multimilijonieriais! (Eurojackpot).

programme.title: Ar galiu užeiti?.
programme.desc: Yra temų, kurios reikalauja išsamaus pokalbio. Šioje laidoje matysite interviu su įtakingais politikais, verslininkais ir visuomenininkais, išgirsite svarbias įžvalgas ir naujas įvykių detales. Laidoje dėmesys skiriamas visuomenę jaudinančioms, aktualioms temos ir pateikiamas platesnis suvokimo kampas. "Delfi interviu" vedėja - patyrusi žurnalistė, ilgametė naujienų portalo redaktorė Rasa Lukaitytė-Vnarauskienė. (Ar galiu užeiti?).

programme.title: River Of No Return.
programme.desc: This reality series follows a small, tight-knit community of people who live in Idaho's remote Frank Church Wilderness, characterized by rugged mountains, deep canyons and roaring rivers, and rely on themselves, the help of their neighbors and a set of survival skills that help them to endure challenging and isolating winters. The residents of "The Frank" tackle everyday life in one of America's last frontiers where they face the many tests Mother Nature throws in their direction, navigate the ordinary domestic challenges of home and family-life and forge unbreakable bonds with those who share their unique lifestyle. This show spotlights how these homesteaders - from twenty-somethings seeking to test their limits, to the living legends who have chosen to spend their lives in Idaho's ''River of No Return'', live on their own terms. (River of No Return). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters.
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business. (Salvage Hunters). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?.
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy. (How Do They Do It?). Mokslas.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers.
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock. (Salvage Hunters: The Restorers). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Scrappers.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid.
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. Two complete strangers -- a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food and water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the two as they attempt to survive on their own for 21 days, with nothing but one personal item each and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. (Naked And Afraid). [12+].

programme.title: How Do They Do It?.
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy. (How Do They Do It?). Mokslas.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers.
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock. (Salvage Hunters: The Restorers). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Scrappers.
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland. (Scrappers).

programme.title: Tiny House Hunters.
programme.desc: Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation? (Tiny House Hunters).

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers.

It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process. (Wheeler Dealers).

programme.title: How Do They Do It?.
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy. (How Do They Do It?). Mokslas.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers.
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock. (Salvage Hunters: The Restorers). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Scrappers.
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland. (Scrappers).

programme.title: Tiny House Hunters.
programme.desc: Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation? (Tiny House Hunters).

programme.title: Salvage Hunters.
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business. (Salvage Hunters). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers.
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process. (Wheeler Dealers).

programme.title: How Do They Do It?.
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy. (How Do They Do It?). Mokslas.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers.
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock. (Salvage Hunters: The Restorers). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Scrappers.
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland. (Scrappers).

programme.title: Tiny House Hunters.
programme.desc: Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation? (Tiny House Hunters).

programme.title: Carfellas.
programme.desc: Meet Mike DeLucia -- Mikey D. for short. Mikey's definitely made some mistakes throughout his life. He's paid the price and now he's ready to make an honest buck - in the used car business. Discovery channel's brand new series CARFELLAS chronicles Mikey's life at his dealership. , reformed convict Mikey D. is joined by his crew, Tommie and Mario. These three steer the wheel of Broadway Motors, Mikey D's used car dealership in Amityville, Long Island. Mike runs the lot, is obsessed with moving inventory and generally keeps the guys in check. Mario knows cars inside and out. He's a skilled appraiser with a keen eye. Tommie, aka "5 x 5" (five feet tall and five feet wide), is the muscle of the operation with a genuine love for Cadillac's, cannoli's, and cute girls. These knock-around guys are experienced at getting money out of people. But this time they are out to make an honest living...selling used cars, Long Island style. (Carfellas).

programme.title: Bad Chad Customs.

Full of creativity, Chad uses anything he can his hands on to complete his extravagant projects, keeping his costs down and his profits up. This reality series follows Chad and his diligent crew as they work around the clock to get these vehicles up and running. (Bad Chad Customs).

programme.title: Homestead Rescue.

They design and build some of the biggest and most amazing diesel powered vehicles you will ever see, and also do truck giveaways. programme.title: How Do They Do It?.
programme.desc: As the modern world becomes progressively automated and mechanised it's easy to become detached from how things are made and how they work. The hit series returns to uncover the miraculous feats of engineering which underpin life in the 21st century. How the seemingly mundane are often the result of highly sophisticated engineering and production processes. This fascinating behind-the-scenes journey delves deep into the production of everyday modern items from surfboards to satchels and trombones to cricket bats. (How Do They Do It?). Mokslas.

programme.title: Border Control: Spain.
programme.desc: The documentary series accompanies the border guards of Spain in their daily fight against crime - on land, at sea and in the air. Around the clock, the men and women are on duty to pre-empt drug traffickers, smugglers and smugglers. programme.title: Body Cam.
programme.desc: Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. Using real footage from the officer's body cameras, we show just how deadly routine checks can be, with law enforcement officials having to think on their feet and make split-second decisions to potentially save their, or someone else's, life. With interviews from the officers involved adding context to the footage, Body Cam Cops gives viewers unprecedented, exclusive access to what life is truly like in the line of duty. (Body Cam). programme.title: Mighty Truckers.
programme.desc: This real-life road show follows the lives of twenty truckers from four different countries - Poland, Italy, Germany and the Netherlands. These unique and diverse characters will show the viewers the world of transport, introducing them with the profession of "truck driver". Who are these men and women who ensure that we get various goods on time day and night? What makes them choose the life on the road? This show will answer these questions in an "up close and personal" portrait of trucker life. (Mighty Truckers).

programme.title: Siberian Cut.
programme.desc: Sean Vann is an American Logger with a plan -- a big plan. He's worked in the Russian forestry industry for the last seventeen years...but he's always been working for a boss. Now Sean is putting everything on the line for the opportunity of a lifetime in deepest Siberia. He has a 3-month contract to cut wood, set up his own operation and become master of his own destiny. There's just one snag: in order to fulfill his dream, Sean needs more men. He brings four American loggers to the frozen wilds of Siberia -- to work alongside his own Siberian crew. If Sean can fulfill his contract with the Russian colonel who runs the land, he is set to make hundreds of thousands of dollars. But if his dual nationality crew can't work together -- and survive temperatures of 40 below -- Sean's dream will be over before it even started. (Siberian Cut). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Incredible Engineering Blunders: Fixed.
programme.desc: Entertaining science series that follows engineering journalist Justin Cunningham and his team as they explore some giant projects around the globe that have major issues and flaws, while they explain what could be done to fix them. From an sinking airport built on a man-made island in Osaka, a stadium roof that is held up by air and in danger of collapsing, to wind turbines in danger of falling into the ocean, and many more, the show uncovers the truth behind each of these outrageous errors and reveals the ingenious solutions engineers have come up with to put things right. (Incredible Engineering Blunders: Fixed).

programme.title: Expedition X.
programme.desc: Join our hosts, adventurer Josh Gates, scientist Phil Torres and paranormal researcher Jessica Chobot, as they travel around the planet uncovering the secrets behind supernatural phenomena, mythical beasts and alien activity. Each trip leads the team on a quest to reveal the bizarre truth of these fascinating stories. Epsiodes include a journey deep into the Cambodian jungle to search for a monster from a lost city; a spelunking expedition sees the team investigating the largest cave system in the world; an active volcano in Washington state might hold the clue to some extraterrestrial mysteries; and an exploration of a haunted dwelling in the Amazon causes panic in the middle of the night. (Expedition X).

programme.title: Hitler's Headquarters.
programme.desc: Throughout the Second World War, Hitler set up numerous bases and headquarters which served various purposes across Poland and Germany. In this ten-part Polish documentary series, presented by historian Lukasz Kazek, viewers are told the story of each unique location, aided by dramatic reconstructions to portray these wartime structures during the devastating conflict. Scattered across both countries, Hitler used these encampments strategically, and each episode delves into the secrets that lay behind the buildings' walls. A fascinating series detailing Hitler's headquarters. (Kwatery Hitlera).

programme.title: River Of No Return.
programme.desc: This reality series follows a small, tight-knit community of people who live in Idaho's remote Frank Church Wilderness, characterized by rugged mountains, deep canyons and roaring rivers, and rely on themselves, the help of their neighbors and a set of survival skills that help them to endure challenging and isolating winters. The residents of "The Frank" tackle everyday life in one of America's last frontiers where they face the many tests Mother Nature throws in their direction, navigate the ordinary domestic challenges of home and family-life and forge unbreakable bonds with those who share their unique lifestyle. This show spotlights how these homesteaders - from twenty-somethings seeking to test their limits, to the living legends who have chosen to spend their lives in Idaho's ''River of No Return'', live on their own terms. (River of No Return). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters.
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business. (Salvage Hunters). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?.
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy. (How Do They Do It?). Mokslas.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid.
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. Two complete strangers -- a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food and water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the two as they attempt to survive on their own for 21 days, with nothing but one personal item each and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, the couple quickly get to know each other -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude will serve them well. (Naked And Afraid). [12+].

programme.title: Ant Anstead Master Mechanic.
programme.desc: To say expert British mechanic Ant Anstead is a lover of cars would be an understatement. The term petrol head does not quite cover the passion he exudes for motor vehicles. One of the vehicles that Ant has a particular obsession with is the 1930s Alfa Romeo 158 Grand Prix race car, one of the greatest racers ever made, which he is honouring in this documentary series by building his own from scratch. We follow Ant and his Alfa on their journey from workshop to race circuit, as he overcomes challenges, setbacks and deadlines to get this commemorative racer ready in time. (Ant Anstead Master Mechanic).

programme.title: Body Cam.
programme.desc: Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. With interviews from the officers involved adding context to the footage, Body Cam Cops gives viewers unprecedented, exclusive access to what life is truly like in the line of duty. (Body Cam). programme.title: How Do They Do It?.
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy. (How Do They Do It?). Mokslas.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers.

programme.title: Scrappers.
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. programme.title: Salvage Hunters.
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business. (Salvage Hunters). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Gold Divers.
programme.desc: Join the group of miners on their quest to find gold in the waters of Nome in Alaska. This reality show follows crews on boats equipped with different gadgets for gold mining- typically consisting of a sluicing apparatus, a means of paydirt collection (dredge) and a cold-water-diving life support system. With many aggravating circumstances such as rough seas, poor underwater visibility, personnel issues, ocean-damaging equipment failures and more, these tough and high tempered people risk their lives every day in hopes of finding gold and getting the big payout. (Bering Sea Gold).

programme.title: Body Cam.
programme.desc: Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. programme.title: Wheeler Dealers.
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process. (Wheeler Dealers).

programme.title: How It's Made.
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made? (How It's Made). Mokslas.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?.
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy. (How Do They Do It?). Mokslas.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers.
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock. (Salvage Hunters: The Restorers). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Scrappers.
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland. (Scrappers).

programme.title: Salvage Hunters.
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business. (Salvage Hunters). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Race Night At Bowman Gray.
programme.desc: It's week two at the infamous Bowman Gray Stadium, and reigning champ Burt Myers hopes for two more wins, while Tim Brown fears a hand injury might end his season early. Jason Myers rushes to repair his battered car and get his season back on track. (Race Night At Bowman Gray).

programme.title: Race Night At Bowman Gray.
programme.desc: Burt Myers hopes to build on his lead and Tim Brown needs a win. With a wreck magnet on the pole and $3000 on the line, anything could happen. (Race Night At Bowman Gray).

programme.title: Homestead Rescue.
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness. (Homestead Rescue). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Diesel Brothers.
programme.desc: Unique American reality series that follows a group of friends in Utah- David ''Heavy D'' Sparks, David ''Diesel Dave'' Kiley, and their crew at ''DieselSellerz'' who sell parts for diesel trucks and jeeps, repair and customize pickup trucks. They design and build some of the biggest and most amazing diesel powered vehicles you will ever see, and also do truck giveaways. Watch as they create these awesome masterpieces and enjoy all the crazy adventures they get into while doing it. (Diesel Brothers).

programme.title: Kindig Customs.
programme.desc: Bitchin' Rides is a reality styled TV show hosted by Dave Kindig from the Salt Lake City, Utah-based company Kindig It Designs. Dave's real passion is designing and building custom cars. We watch the process of restoring and rebuilding all types and all periods of cars. In each episode Dave and his team review a car, create a design, then the team takes it apart and rebuilds to create a one-of-a-kind gem. Things get really ugly before they get pretty. Dave has the best team of top mechanics, technicians and fabricators in the business, quality is their only focus when they create the baddest bitchin' rides. (Kindig Customs).

programme.title: How Do They Do It?.
programme.desc: As the modern world becomes progressively automated and mechanised it's easy to become detached from how things are made and how they work. The hit series returns to uncover the miraculous feats of engineering which underpin life in the 21st century. How the seemingly mundane are often the result of highly sophisticated engineering and production processes. This fascinating behind-the-scenes journey delves deep into the production of everyday modern items from surfboards to satchels and trombones to cricket bats. (How Do They Do It?). Mokslas.

programme.title: Border Control: Spain.
programme.desc: The documentary series accompanies the border guards of Spain in their daily fight against crime - on land, at sea and in the air. Around the clock, the men and women are on duty to pre-empt drug traffickers, smugglers and smugglers. The role of the security forces is manifold: from the fight against hashish transport in the strait of Gibraltar to the smashing of organized human trafficking at the airport in Madrid to the search for counterfeit branded goods in the port of Barcelona. (Control de Fronteras: España).

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers: Dream Car.
programme.desc: Join our hosts, expert car dealer Mike Brewer and ex-Formula 1 mechanic Marc 'Elvis' Priestly, as they try to negotiate the best deals when buying, transforming and selling cars, vans and motorcycles. Their goal is to help out unlucky petrolheads who want to trade up to get their dream car and Mike and Marc only have five deals to earn enough funds to mak the final purchase. Episodes see the duo trading up to an iconic Series 2A Land Rover for ex-soldier, Tony; making enough cash to buy a classic Mk2 Ford Escort for office manager, Chris; turning a decrepit Fiat Doblo into a mini-camper; and finding the original hot-hatch, a Golf GTi, for teaching assistant, Jess. (Wheeler Dealers: Dream Car).

programme.title: Salvage Hunters.
programme.desc: Meet modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard. With demanding customers, high turnover, and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life! (Salvage Hunters). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: How It's Made.
programme.desc: The local social cricket team are up to bat and sometimes it seems they are one batsman short of of an eleven. There are good secrets and not so good secrets that come to light during the course of the day. Roger is the ultimate captain rallying his troops whilst ignoring his greatest strength, Miriam, who makes the 'fantastic' teas with or without the 'non-compulsory' help. The days builds to a climax where it seems that everything must change forever. But will it? (How It's Made). Mokslas.

programme.title: How It's Made.
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made? (How It's Made). Mokslas.

programme.title: Mighty Truckers.
programme.desc: This real-life road show follows the lives of twenty truckers from four different countries - Poland, Italy, Germany and the Netherlands. These unique and diverse characters will show the viewers the world of transport, introducing them with the profession of "truck driver". Who are these men and women who ensure that we get various goods on time day and night? What makes them choose the life on the road? This show will answer these questions in an "up close and personal" portrait of trucker life. (Mighty Truckers).

programme.title: Siberian Cut.
programme.desc: Sean Vann is an American Logger with a plan -- a big plan. He's worked in the Russian forestry industry for the last seventeen years...but he's always been working for a boss. Now Sean is putting everything on the line for the opportunity of a lifetime in deepest Siberia. He has a 3-month contract to cut wood, set up his own operation and become master of his own destiny. There's just one snag: in order to fulfill his dream, Sean needs more men. He brings four American loggers to the frozen wilds of Siberia -- to work alongside his own Siberian crew. If Sean can fulfill his contract with the Russian colonel who runs the land, he is set to make hundreds of thousands of dollars. But if his dual nationality crew can't work together -- and survive temperatures of 40 below -- Sean's dream will be over before it even started. (Siberian Cut). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: American Chopper.
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true. (American Chopper).

programme.title: Incredible Engineering Blunders: Fixed.
programme.desc: Entertaining science series that follows engineering journalist Justin Cunningham and his team as they explore some giant projects around the globe that have major issues and flaws, while they explain what could be done to fix them. From an sinking airport built on a man-made island in Osaka, a stadium roof that is held up by air and in danger of collapsing, to wind turbines in danger of falling into the ocean, and many more, the show uncovers the truth behind each of these outrageous errors and reveals the ingenious solutions engineers have come up with to put things right. (Incredible Engineering Blunders: Fixed).

programme.title: Expedition Unknown.
programme.desc: Expedition Unknown chronicles the adventures of Josh Gates as he investigates iconic mysteries across the globe. Gates begins by interviewing key eyewitnesses and uncovering recent developments in the story, then springboards into a fully immersive exploration. This authentic, roughshod adventure leads Gates closer to the truth behind these unanswered global enigmas, such as the disappearance of Amelia Earhart's plane. Josh Gates is an adventurer and avid explorer with a unique brand of humor and passion for off-the-map excursions. (Expedition Unknown). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Gold Rush.
programme.desc: Gold Rush is a reality television series that follows the placer gold mining efforts of various family-run mining companies in boundless north of America. The series focuses on the work process in the conditions of permafrost and working relations between the participants. The show has 10 seasons altogether. In some episodes participants start the adventure and travel to Alaska to search for gold because of financial issues. They do not have any previous experience and have to learn on the job. Then there appears several gold mining teams that compete with each other. In some episodes the teams move to South America. Admire the courage and determination of the team members in their unstoppable desire to become rich. (Gold Rush). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Expedition X.
programme.desc: Join our hosts, adventurer Josh Gates, scientist Phil Torres and paranormal researcher Jessica Chobot, as they travel around the planet uncovering the secrets behind supernatural phenomena, mythical beasts and alien activity. Each trip leads the team on a quest to reveal the bizarre truth of these fascinating stories. Epsiodes include a journey deep into the Cambodian jungle to search for a monster from a lost city; a spelunking expedition sees the team investigating the largest cave system in the world; an active volcano in Washington state might hold the clue to some extraterrestrial mysteries; and an exploration of a haunted dwelling in the Amazon causes panic in the middle of the night. (Expedition X).

programme.title: Hitler's Headquarters.
programme.desc: Throughout the Second World War, Hitler set up numerous bases and headquarters which served various purposes across Poland and Germany. In this ten-part Polish documentary series, presented by historian Lukasz Kazek, viewers are told the story of each unique location, aided by dramatic reconstructions to portray these wartime structures during the devastating conflict. Scattered across both countries, Hitler used these encampments strategically, and each episode delves into the secrets that lay behind the buildings' walls. A fascinating series detailing Hitler's headquarters. (Kwatery Hitlera).

This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland. (Scrappers).

programme.desc: Floridoje, Klirvoteryje, vidury nakties iš savo buto dingsta aštuonmetis Zacharijus Bernhardtas. Jo motina buvo išėjusi greitai nusimaudyti namo baseine, o grįžusi neberado jo lovoje. Jokių įsilaužimo žymių taip pat nėra. (Disappeared). [18+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: "Vanity Fair" slaptai.
programme.desc: Baltųjų rasės iškėlimas ir neapykanta kitokiems paskatina jauną vyrą 2015 m. Čarslote nužudyti devynis juodaodžius bažnyčios narius ir sukurti prieš musulmonų pabėgėlius Kanzase nukreiptą žiaurų sprogdinimo planą. Pareigūnai siekia išsiaiškinti, kuo visa tai baigsis. (Vanity Fair Confidential). [14+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Žmogžudystė per medaus mėnesį: kas nužudė Anę?.
programme.desc: Kai moteris pagrobiama ir nužudoma savo medaus mėnesio metu, visi desperatiškai nori sužinoti, kas dėl to kaltas. (Anni: The Honeymoon Murder). [12+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Pirmos 48 valandos.
programme.desc: Narkotikų sandėris automobilių stovėjimo aikštelėje virsta susišaudymu, pareikalavusiu dviejų Atlantos gyventojų gyvybių; egzekucija prie Talsos motelio virsta dviguba žmogžudyste, kai žudikas pastebi liudininką. (The First 48). [12+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Samdoma žmogžudystė.
programme.desc: Pinigų trokštanti žmona paprašo kelių nepažįstamųjų nužudyti savo vyrą. Įvykiai vystosi tarsi Holivudo trileryje - policija filmuoja kiekvieną siaubingo plano žingsnį. (Murder for Hire). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Venkite Brendono.
programme.desc: Kai Amber sutinka Brendoną, jis tampa jos svajonių vyru, ir jų audringas romanas baigiasi santuoka. Tačiau keistų įvykių seka meilę paverčia įtarimais, ir tik vienas žmogus gali padėti atskleisti tiesą: Brendono buvusi žmona Atėnė. (Don't Date Brandon). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.
programme.desc: Mičigane, Sagino miestelyje, gyvenęs 38-erių Ericas Lee Franksas 2013 m. persikelia į Ohajų, kad galėtų geriau pažinti paauglę dukrą, apie kurią anksčiau nieko nežinojo. Prabėgus 6 mėnesiams, jo motina Mičigane praneša apie be žinios dingusį sūnų. (Disappeared). [18+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: "Vanity Fair" slaptai.
programme.desc: Kriminalinis serialas, atskleidžiantis baudžiamųjų bylų subtilybes ir kaltinamuosius, jų istorijas, kurios jau buvo aprašytos Vanity Fair žurnalo puslapiuose. Apimtos garsios, skandalingos rezonansines bylos, kuriose figuruoja kareiviai, šeimos įpėdinai ir turtingieji. (Vanity Fair Confidential). [14+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Žudikas šeimoje: Bekės Vats žmogžudystė.
programme.desc: Paauglė mergina dingsta iš savo namų Bristolyje, o tai paskatina didžiules paieškas visame mieste ir socialinių tinklų kampaniją, siekiant ją surasti. Praėjus kelioms dienoms, auga baimė, kad jai galėjo nutikti kas nors negero. programme.desc: Amber ir Atėnė pradeda podcastą, kad papasakotų savo istoriją ir įspėtų moteris apie Brendoną. Kai jis bando jas nutildyti teisme, jos susimąsto, iš kur jis gauna pinigų. Apie paskutines jos lankytas vietas paaiškėjusios detalės glaudžioje bendruomenėje kelia daug įtarimų. (Disappeared). [18+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Venkite Brendono.
programme.desc: Kai ji su juo išsiskiria, įvykiai perauga į bauginantį užpuolimą ir bandymą pagrobti... ir visa tai fiksuoja kamera. (Don't Date Brandon). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.
programme.desc: Pasimatymo vakaras Filadelfijoje persmelkiamas nerimo - pora dingsta be žinios. Paieškoms susivienija abi šeimos, tačiau augant įtampai prasideda kaltinimai vieni kitiems. Netrukus mįslingą, spėlionėmis apaugusią bylą perima FTB agentai. (Disappeared). [18+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: "Vanity Fair" slaptai.
programme.desc: Jauno, kultinio autoriaus J.T. LeRoy meteoriškas iškilimas į literatūros žvaigždes išties stebina. Tačiau atrodo, kad kuo daugiau knygų jis parduoda, tuo keistesnis tampa jo elgesys. Tai per greitai gautos per didelės šlovės padarinys? O gal užkulisiuose vyksta kažkas negero? (Vanity Fair Confidential). [14+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Džėjaus Sleiterio dingimas.
programme.desc: 2024 m., praėjus vos kelioms valandoms po Džėjaus Sleiterio dingimo, didžiulis susidomėjimas internete sukėlė gausybę vis drąsesnių sąmokslo teorijų. Šis dokumentinis filmas turi išskirtinę galimybę susipažinti su Džėjaus šeima, kuri ieško atsakymų dėl jo mirties. (The Disappearance of Jay Slater). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Pirmos 48 valandos.
programme.desc: Atlantoje mergina namuose aptinka jauno tėvo kūną. Detektyvai suranda žudiką, tačiau pasirodo, kad ne viskas yra taip, kaip atrodė iš pradžių. Tuo tarpu Talsoje nušautas paauglys verčia policiją desperatiškai ieškoti nusikaltimo motyvo. (The First 48). [12+]. Kriminalai.

(A Killer in the Family: The Murder of Becky Watts). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Žudikas šeimoje: Bekės Vats žmogžudystė.
programme.desc: Paauglė mergina dingsta iš savo namų Bristolyje, o tai paskatina didžiules paieškas visame mieste ir socialinių tinklų kampaniją, siekiant ją surasti. Praėjus kelioms dienoms, auga baimė, kad jai galėjo nutikti kas nors negero. Vykstant policijos tyrimui, randami šokiruojantys įrodymai, inkriminuojantys jos šeimos narį, tačiau niekas negalėjo įsivaizduoti, kas nutiks toliau. (A Killer in the Family: The Murder of Becky Watts). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Džėjaus Sleiterio dingimas.
programme.desc: 2024 m., praėjus vos kelioms valandoms po Džėjaus Sleiterio dingimo, didžiulis susidomėjimas internete sukėlė gausybę vis drąsesnių sąmokslo teorijų. Šis dokumentinis filmas turi išskirtinę galimybę susipažinti su Džėjaus šeima, kuri ieško atsakymų dėl jo mirties. (The Disappearance of Jay Slater). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Pirmos 48 valandos.
programme.desc: Narkotikų sandėris automobilių stovėjimo aikštelėje virsta susišaudymu, pareikalavusiu dviejų Atlantos gyventojų gyvybių; egzekucija prie Talsos motelio virsta dviguba žmogžudyste, kai žudikas pastebi liudininką. (The First 48). [12+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Pirmos 48 valandos.
programme.desc: Mobilėje, Alabamoje, paslaptingas lankytojas viešbučio kambaryje nušauna 21 metų moterį; tuo pat metu Gvineto apygardos bute randamas kulkų suvarpytas 42-ejų muzikos prodiuserio kūnas. Visi įkalčiai rodo, kad į žmones šaudo pamišėlis. (The First 48). [12+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Samdoma žmogžudystė.
programme.desc: Pinigų trokštanti žmona paprašo kelių nepažįstamųjų nužudyti savo vyrą. Įvykiai vystosi tarsi Holivudo trileryje - policija filmuoja kiekvieną siaubingo plano žingsnį. (Murder for Hire). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Turtingi ir begėdžiai.
programme.desc: Dar niekada nepasakota tikra istorija apie garsiausio sekso įrašo vagystę, paviešinimą ir išnaudojimą. Pirmą kartą papasakota pačių įvykių dalyvių. (Rich & Shameless). [12+]. Kriminalai. Laisvalaikio. Biografija.

programme.title: Turtingi ir begėdžiai.
programme.desc: Žvilgsnis į tariamai nekaltą pramogą - šlapių marškinėlių konkursus, bei alkoholiu persmelktų pavasario atostogų tamsius užkulisius su Joe Francisu. (Rich & Shameless). [12+]. Laisvalaikio. Biografija. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Duo Mix.
programme.desc: Naktis pilna muzikinių klipų įvairiems skoniams. Šokite, dainuokite kartu ar tiesiog mėgaukitės muzika po antklode. (Duo Mix). Muzikiniai.

programme.title: Kaip sugauti savo persekiotoją.
programme.desc: Greisė ir Darilas laimingai gyvena Vatforde, kol pavojingas persekiotojas pradeda viską griauti. Niekas negali jiems padėti. Jiems reikia įrodymų. Todėl jie pradeda viską filmuoti. (Catching My Stalker). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Įsimintinas nusikaltimas.
programme.desc: Linkolnas, Nebraska, 1958 m. Kai du nuo meilės ir sekso pamišę paaugliai leidžiasi į siautulingą žmogžudysčių kelionę, vienas vietos šerifas turi sustabdyti šį košmarišką pasivažinėjimą. (A Crime to Remember). [12+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Pirmos 48 valandos.
programme.desc: Atlantoje mergina namuose aptinka jauno tėvo kūną. Detektyvai suranda žudiką, tačiau pasirodo, kad ne viskas yra taip, kaip atrodė iš pradžių. Tuo tarpu Talsoje nušautas paauglys verčia policiją desperatiškai ieškoti nusikaltimo motyvo. (The First 48). [12+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Pirmos 48 valandos.
programme.desc: Narkotikų sandėris automobilių stovėjimo aikštelėje virsta susišaudymu, pareikalavusiu dviejų Atlantos gyventojų gyvybių; egzekucija prie Talsos motelio virsta dviguba žmogžudyste, kai žudikas pastebi liudininką. (The First 48). [12+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Pirmos 48 valandos.
programme.desc: Narkotikų sandėris automobilių stovėjimo aikštelėje virsta susišaudymu, pareikalavusiu dviejų Atlantos gyventojų gyvybių; egzekucija prie Talsos motelio virsta dviguba žmogžudyste, kai žudikas pastebi liudininką. (The First 48). [12+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Turtingi ir begėdžiai.
programme.desc: Kai mažai žinomas rizikos fondų finansinis genijus Martinas Shkreli netikėtai pakelia pigių AIDS vaistų kainą, jis greitai tampa labiausiai nekenčiamu žmogumi Amerikoje. Užuot atsitraukęs, jis įsivelia į keistą žodžių karą su hiphopo legendomis "Wu-Tang Clan" dėl nuosavybės teisių į daugiamilijoninį slaptą albumą. (Rich & Shameless). Biografija. Kriminalai. Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Turtingi ir begėdžiai.
programme.desc: Istorija apie NBA žvaigždę Bisoną Dele, žinomą kaip Brianas Williamsas. Jis turėjo viską, bet atsisakė karjeros dėl klajokliško gyvenimo būdo, ir paslaptingai dingo plaukdamas pietinėje Ramiajo vandenyno dalyje. Williamso gyvenimą tirti pradėjusi policija atranda mirtiną pinigų ir pavydo mišinį, kuris nuvedė tiesiai į jo šeimą. (Rich & Shameless). [12+]. Biografija. Laisvalaikio. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Venkite Brendono.
programme.desc: Kai ji su juo išsiskiria, įvykiai perauga į bauginantį užpuolimą ir bandymą pagrobti... ir visa tai fiksuoja kamera. (Don't Date Brandon). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Casey Anthony: amerikietiškos žmogžudystės paslaptis.
programme.desc: Casey Anthony tikina, kad jos 2 metų dukrą Caylee pagrobė auklė, tačiau netrukus paaiškėja, kad Caylee dingusi jau 31 dieną. (Casey Anthony: An American Murder Mystery). Biografija. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Casey Anthony: amerikietiškos žmogžudystės paslaptis.
programme.desc: Prasidėjus Casey Anthony teismo procesui, gynyba pateikia šokiruojančius kaltinimus, o kaltintojai atskleidžia teoriją, kaip, jų manymu, mirė Caylee. (Casey Anthony: An American Murder Mystery). Kriminalai. Biografija.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.
programme.desc: Kalifornijoje, Hartvorde, važinėdamasi "dirt" dviračiu be žinios dingsta 19-metė Angel Garcia. Draugai sako, kad prieš dingimą ją persekiojo neaiškus visureigis. Prabėgus mėnesiui pranešama, kad panaši mergina pastebėta parduotuvėje, už 25 km. Ar tai galėjo būti Angel? (Disappeared). [18+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.
programme.desc: 35-erių mama Deanne Hastings palieka raštelį, kad bėga iki parduotuvės, ir dingsta be žinios. Spokano detektyvams išsiaiškinant vis daugiau detalių apie Deanne veiksmus prieš dingimą, pradedamos kelti grėsmingos teorijos. (Disappeared). Kriminalai.

programme.title: "Vanity Fair" slaptai.
programme.desc: Jauno, kultinio autoriaus J.T. LeRoy meteoriškas iškilimas į literatūros žvaigždes išties stebina. Tačiau atrodo, kad kuo daugiau knygų jis parduoda, tuo keistesnis tampa jo elgesys. Tai per greitai gautos per didelės šlovės padarinys? O gal užkulisiuose vyksta kažkas negero? (Vanity Fair Confidential). [14+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: "Vanity Fair" slaptai.
programme.desc: Ji - modelis. "Playboy" mergina. Bet ar ji taip pat yra žudikė? Kai kurie žmonės Lawrencią "Bambi" Bembenek vadina televizijai sukurta žudike. Kiti sako, kad ji nekalta. Dabar du "Vanity Fair" žurnalistai nori išsiaiškinti, ar ji tikrai nuspaudė gaiduką. O gal Bambi buvo nepagrįstai apkaltinta? (Vanity Fair Confidential). [14+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: "Vanity Fair" slaptai.
programme.desc: Kriminalinis serialas, atskleidžiantis baudžiamųjų bylų subtilybes ir kaltinamuosius, jų istorijas, kurios jau buvo aprašytos Vanity Fair žurnalo puslapiuose. Apimtos garsios, skandalingos rezonansines bylos, kuriose figuruoja kareiviai, šeimos įpėdinai ir turtingieji. (Vanity Fair Confidential). [14+]. Kriminalai.

programme.desc: Paslaptinga istorija, kuri gaubia bitkoinų milijonieriaus Geraldo Cottono mirtį įtartinomis aplinkybėmis, kai 2019 m. šimtai milijonų dolerių staiga dingo iš jo kriptovaliutų sąskaitos. (Rich & Shameless). Biografija. Laisvalaikio. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Casey Anthony: amerikietiškos žmogžudystės paslaptis.
programme.desc: Tęsiantis žmogžudyste apkaltintos Casey Anthony teismui, pagrindinę poziciją užima gynybos komanda. Prisiekusiems prireikia vos 11 valandų sprendimui priimti. (Casey Anthony: An American Murder Mystery). Biografija. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.
programme.desc: Džiaugsminga 14-metė Ashley Summers be žinios dingsta liepos 4 d. Jos šeima sugniuždyta. Paslaptis dar pagilėja, kai FTB agentai jos bylą pradeda sieti su kaimynystėje dingusių dviejų merginų istorijomis. Prabėgus dešimčiai metų vis dar nėra atsakymo, kas nutiko. (Disappeared). Kriminalai.

programme.title: "Vanity Fair" slaptai.
programme.desc: Niujorke dingus jaunai moteriai, jos šeima įsitikinusi, kad ji buvo nužudyta. Bet kaip pagauti nežinomą žudiką, kai negalima įrodyti net nusikaltimo fakto? Atsidavę tyrėjai pasiryžę išsiaiškinti, kas iš tikrųjų įvyko. (Vanity Fair Confidential). [14+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Įsimintinas nusikaltimas.
programme.desc: Kanzas Sitis, Misūris, 1960 m. Kai kulkų suvarpytas Patricijos Jones kūnas aptinkamas įsimylėjėlių kelio pakraštyje, detektyvas Browningas leidžiasi į "pagauk, jei gali" tipo kelionę nuo Misūrio iki Meksikos, erzinamas provokuojančių savo gudraus priešininko šypsenų. (A Crime to Remember). Kriminalai.

programme.desc: Paslaptinga istorija, kuri gaubia bitkoinų milijonieriaus Geraldo Cottono mirtį įtartinomis aplinkybėmis, kai 2019 m. šimtai milijonų dolerių staiga dingo iš jo kriptovaliutų sąskaitos. (Rich & Shameless). Kriminalai. Laisvalaikio. Biografija.

programme.title: Casey Anthony: amerikietiškos žmogžudystės paslaptis.
programme.desc: Tęsiantis žmogžudyste apkaltintos Casey Anthony teismui, pagrindinę poziciją užima gynybos komanda. Prisiekusiems prireikia vos 11 valandų sprendimui priimti. (Casey Anthony: An American Murder Mystery). Biografija. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.
programme.desc: Džiaugsminga 14-metė Ashley Summers be žinios dingsta liepos 4 d. Jos šeima sugniuždyta. Paslaptis dar pagilėja, kai FTB agentai jos bylą pradeda sieti su kaimynystėje dingusių dviejų merginų istorijomis. Prabėgus dešimčiai metų vis dar nėra atsakymo, kas nutiko. (Disappeared). Kriminalai.

programme.title: "Vanity Fair" slaptai.
programme.desc: Niujorke dingus jaunai moteriai, jos šeima įsitikinusi, kad ji buvo nužudyta. Bet kaip pagauti nežinomą žudiką, kai negalima įrodyti net nusikaltimo fakto? Atsidavę tyrėjai pasiryžę išsiaiškinti, kas iš tikrųjų įvyko. (Vanity Fair Confidential). [14+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Įsimintinas nusikaltimas.
programme.desc: Kanzas Sitis, Misūris, 1960 m. Kai kulkų suvarpytas Patricijos Jones kūnas aptinkamas įsimylėjėlių kelio pakraštyje, detektyvas Browningas leidžiasi į "pagauk, jei gali" tipo kelionę nuo Misūrio iki Meksikos, erzinamas provokuojančių savo gudraus priešininko šypsenų. (A Crime to Remember). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Pirmos 48 valandos.

programme.title: Turtingi ir begėdžiai.
programme.desc: Clare Bronfman, vieno didžiausių pasaulio turtų paveldėtoja, susitinka su charizmatišku savipagalbos guru ir įsitraukia į vieną labiausiai piktnaudžiaujančių XXI amžiaus kultų. (Rich & Shameless). Laisvalaikio. Biografija. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Niujorko žmogžudystės.
programme.desc: Milijonierė bankininkė bei dviejų vaikų motina Shele Covlin buvo pasiekusi viską, tačiau paslydo ir užsimušė aukštutinio Vest Saido vonioje. Po laidotuvių paaiškėjus naujiems faktams Niujorko policija pradeda įtarti, kad tai nebuvo nelaimingas atsitikimas. (New York Homicide). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.
programme.desc: Loganas Schiendelmanas dingsta be žinios, pareigūnai randa paliktą jo mašiną. Ne vienas žmogus praneša, kad matė Loganą, tačiau paieškos neduoda jokių rezultatų. Nėra jokių įrodymų, kad įvykdytas nusikaltimas, tačiau ieškodami atsakymų į kylančius klausimus, policijos pareigūnai pradeda tirti kontroversišką šeimos istoriją. (Disappeared). Kriminalai.

programme.title: "Vanity Fair" slaptai.
programme.desc: Ji yra scientologijos pirmoji dama, Bažnyčios vadovo žmona. Kai Shelly Miscavige dingsta iš viešumos, visuomenė ir kai kurie buvę Bažnyčios nariai nori sužinoti, kas nutiko dingusiai scientologijos karalienei? (Vanity Fair Confidential). [14+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Įsimintinas nusikaltimas.
programme.desc: Sent Polas, Minesota, 1963 m. Pamaldi ir atsidavusi keturių vaikų motina Carol Thompson randama pasruvusi krauju ant kaimyno slenksčio. Dabar detektyvai turi vieną po kito nulupti jos tobulo gyvenimo sluoksnius ir atskleisti skaudžias septinto dešimtmečio namų šeimininkės paslaptis. (A Crime to Remember). [12+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Turtingi ir begėdžiai.
programme.desc: Istorija apie milijardierių mados verslininką Peterį Nygardą ir jo keistą siekį sustabdyti senėjimą, kuris atveda prie daugybės kaltinimų piktnaudžiavimu bei stulbinančio nuopuolio. (Rich & Shameless). Laisvalaikio. Kriminalai. Biografija.

programme.title: Niujorko žmogžudystės.
programme.desc: Linda Stein buvo žvaigždžių nekilnojamojo turto agentė, pardavinėjusi prabangius Niujorko butus tokiems žmonėms kaip Stenevas Spielbergas, Bruce'as Willisas bei Bettė Midler. Žinia, kad Linda buvo mirtinai uždaužyta savo bute, iš karto patenka į pirmus laikraščių puslapius. Išskirtinė jos asmenybė reiškė, kad Linda turėjo tiek priešų, tiek gerbėjų. Kadangi įvykio vietoje nebuvo beveik jokių įkalčių, žudiką nustatyti gali tik kruopštus detektyvų darbas. (New York Homicide). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.
programme.desc: Per Karibų kruizą 23-ejų Amy Bradley be pėdsakų dingsta iš šeimos namelio. Dešimtmečius nežinioje paskendę šeimos nariai nenutraukia paieškų. Jie sako, kad ieškodami mylimos Amy gali paaukoti viską. (Disappeared). Kriminalai.

programme.title: "Vanity Fair" slaptai.
programme.desc: Aktorės karjeros siekiančią Vicki Morgan jos kambariokas mirtinai sumuša beisbolo lazda. Išgirdus prisipažinimą, policijai atrodo, kad laukia paprasta ir aiški byla. Tačiau įvykiai greitai pakrypsta taip, kad visi pradeda svarstyti, kas iš tikrųjų nužudė Vicki Morgan? (Vanity Fair Confidential). [14+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Turtingi ir begėdžiai.
programme.desc: Dėl įspūdingo talento ir laukinių vakarėlių superžvaigžde tapęs NBA krepšininkas Dennisas Rodmanas tampa artimiausių žmonių išdavystės bei vagystės auka. (Rich & Shameless). Kriminalai. Biografija. Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Niujorko žmogžudystės.
programme.desc: Metro traukinyje, Brukline, randamas nušautas į pensiją išėjęs policininkas, o detektyvai netrunka nustatyti, kad jo mirtis susijusi su kitomis šaudynėmis per pastarąsias 13 valandų. Atrodo, kad aukos pasirinktos atsitiktinai, todėl kita auka gali tapti bet kuris niujorkietis. Įtariamuosius reikia surasti anksčiau, nei jie surengs dar vieną išpuolį. (New York Homicide). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.
programme.desc: Devynmetė Stephanie Crane išeina iš vietinio boulingo klubo, tačiau namų nepasiekia. Pirmosios paieškos neduoda jokių rezultatų. Ilgus metus policija neranda mergaitės, nesulaiko įtariamojo. Dabar jie tikisi, kad bylą išnarplioti gali padėti patobulėjusios įkalčių tyrimo technologijos. (Disappeared). Kriminalai.

programme.title: "Vanity Fair" slaptai.
programme.desc: Kriminalinis serialas, atskleidžiantis baudžiamųjų bylų subtilybes ir kaltinamuosius, jų istorijas, kurios jau buvo aprašytos Vanity Fair žurnalo puslapiuose. Apimtos garsios, skandalingos rezonansines bylos, kuriose figuruoja kareiviai, šeimos įpėdinai ir turtingieji. (Vanity Fair Confidential). [14+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Įsimintinas nusikaltimas.
programme.desc: 1941 m. Niujorke, Bronkse, arbatėlė dviese baigiasi žmogžudyste, o žudiką atsakomybėn norintys patraukti tyrėjai turi tikėtis, kad daug drąsių moterų išdrįs liudyti apie savo siaubingas patirtis. (A Crime to Remember). Kriminalai.

Atrodo, kad aukos pasirinktos atsitiktinai, todėl kita auka gali tapti bet kuris niujorkietis. Įtariamuosius reikia surasti anksčiau, nei jie surengs dar vieną išpuolį. (New York Homicide). Kriminalai.

programme.desc: Pasakojimas apie Amerikos ikoną bei pasaulinio garso imtynininką Hulką Hoganą. Jis turėjo viską: gerbėjus, pinigų, mylinčią šeimą, netgi savo televizijos laidą... bet žiniasklaidai nutekėjęs garsusis sekso įrašas amžiams pakeitė jo gyvenimą. Šis filmas atskleidžia skandalą, kuris vystėsi už ringo, žmogaus kovą su savo paties legenda bei lemtingą kovą už teisę į privatumą. (Rich & Shameless). Biografija. Laisvalaikio. Kriminalai.

programme.desc: Brolių bei seserų konfliktui dėl pinigų peraugus į dvigubą žmogžudystę, dingusio žudiko ieško visas Bruklinas. Dienos išsitęsia iki mėnesių, vėliau iki metų, o Niujorko policijos gaudynės išsiplečia į visą JAV, o vėliau - už šalies ribų. (New York Homicide). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.
programme.desc: Virdžinijoje, Šarlotsvilyje, be žinios dingsta translytis paauglys Cage Smith. Policija netrukus nustato įtariamąjį. Tačiau tyrimo metu paaiškėję įkalčiai priverčia detektyvus atidžiau patikrinti artimiausius Sage aplinkos žmones. (Disappeared). [18+]. Kriminalai.
